name: Rim Frontier
description: The outer reaches are hard to reach and hold: an ion-storm belt, thinning stars, gravity shoals that pull ships out of hyperspace, little fuel and poor sensor coverage. Ordinary empires start inside the belt, pirate bases split rim/core, and pirate factions hunt rim fauna herds for bounty. Stacks with The Rim Trade and Rim Fauna.

flags.name: rimFrontier
flags.label: Rim frontier geography
flags.description: Storm belt, sparser rim, gravity shoals, inward fuel, rim sensor fog and the map-scale options below.
